title: 4.1 Graphing Polynomial Functions

icans: I can identify polynomial functions and give their degree, type, and leading coefficient.
I can describe the end behavior of polynomial functions and graph them.

vocab: f(x) = aₙxⁿ + … + a₁x + a₀ with _______________ exponents
the coefficient of the term with the ___________ exponent (in standard form)

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Degree and leading coefficient: Degree = the greatest _______________. Leading coefficient = coefficient of the term with the _______________.

blocks.stem:
Decide whether each function is a polynomial function. If it is, write it in standard form and give its degree, type, and leading coefficient.
a.  f(x) = 5x − 2x³ − 8        b.  g(x) = x² + 3x⁻¹        c.  h(x) = 6 − √2x⁴        d.  k(x) = 5ˣ

notes: End behavior: Even degree: ends go the _______________ way. Odd degree: ends go _______________ ways.
Negative leading coefficient: A negative leading coefficient _______________ the ends.

blocks.stem:
Describe the end behavior.
a.  f(x) = −0.5x⁴ + 3x² − 1        b.  g(x) = 2x⁵ − x
The graph shows a polynomial function. Is its degree even or odd? Is its leading coefficient positive or negative?
Write f(x) = 4 − 7x + x³ in standard form. Give its degree, type, and leading coefficient.
Describe the end behavior of f(x) = −3x³ + x.

tickets.stem: Give the degree and the leading coefficient of f(x) = 5x² − 2x⁴ + 1.
Evaluate f(x) = x³ − x when x = 2.
Describe the end behavior of f(x) = x⁶.
